name: Evidence is specific and names its source
better: Each claim points at a dated note, a call or a document, and says what happened.

name: Strengths and concerns are balanced
better: The concerns the material holds get the same weight as the strengths.

name: Nothing over-claimed from self-report
better: What the executive says about themselves is kept apart from what someone else confirms.

name: No invented facts
better: Nothing is stated that the case does not hold.
